_description: No input besides Start. Pure gravity (Constants.g=1.6) from the initial position (45,50)m. Lands ~7.9s in; checkpoints at 2s/5s (in-flight trajectory) and 9s (after touchdown). This is the same free-fall scenario used in Phase 0's own comparison (see docs/KIRO_NOTES.md and work/lunar-lander/compare/run-comparison.mjs) - re-run here through the formalized src/verify/ harness instead of the ad hoc Phase 0 scripts.
_expectedOutcome: crashLanded (landing speed ~12.6-12.7 m/s, well above damageLandingSpeed=12 and hardLandingSpeed=6; angle=0 throughout, so classification is driven entirely by speed, not the angle quirk - contrast with crash-tilt.json).
